## NEXUS Lite — Alert Triage

### How it works

1. A webhook receives an alert payload via POST and validates required fields (alert_id, severity, source, description).
2. Scoring rules and tier thresholds are loaded from Google Sheets.
3. The scoring engine evaluates each active rule against the payload and sums matched weights.
4. The classifier assigns a tier (RED / AMBER / GREEN) based on configured score ranges.
5. Route & Notify determines the action: Slack alert for RED, review queue for AMBER, auto-close for GREEN.
6. The scored item is written to the Items sheet and an audit entry is appended to Execution_Log.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Duplicate the NEXUS_Config_v1 Google Sheets template and copy the spreadsheet ID.
- [ ] Replace `REPLACE-WITH-YOUR-GOOGLE-SHEET-ID` in every Sheets node with your spreadsheet ID.
- [ ] Connect a Google Sheets OAuth2 credential to each Sheets node.
- [ ] Paste your Slack Incoming Webhook URL into the "Slack Send" node URL field.
- [ ] Activate the workflow and POST a test payload to `/webhook/alert-triage-lite`.

### Customization

Edit scoring rules, tier thresholds, and notification targets directly in Google Sheets — no code changes required.

## Receive and validate payload

Accepts incoming webhook POST requests, checks for required fields, and returns HTTP 400 with a missing-field list if validation fails.

## Load config and score

Reads active scoring rules and tier thresholds from Google Sheets, evaluates each rule against the payload, and sums matched weights.

## Route and notify

Loads notification targets from Google Sheets, determines the notification action based on tier, and fires a Slack webhook for RED-tier alerts.

## Persist results

Writes the scored item to the Items sheet and appends an event record to the Execution_Log audit trail.

## Route by tier and respond

Dispatches the result to the correct tier branch (RED / AMBER / GREEN) and sends the HTTP 200 response back to the caller.
